slots.extractedText: Wall thickness t, 2.4 mm  t  2 mm

True impact rate (TIR) < 10%, crack
through the full thickness of the pipe
wall

Percentage change in length  2.5%
at test temperature 120C

- No leakage;
- An appropriate ball to pass freely
through it;
- Maximum defection at any place in
the system between the two adjacent
supports shall be not greater than
1/10 of the nominal bore of the pipe
incorporated in the test assembly.

- No failure in the first 14 strikes; or
- Less than five failures in the total of
42 strikes.

- Temperature  90C for minimum
wall thickness < 2.7 mm;
- Temperature  80C for minimum
wall thickness  2.7 mm.
